item.title: U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse, steep tariffs loom
item.description: Negotiations between the U.S. and Canada broke down late Friday, with both sides confirming that significant new tariffs will take effect.

item.title: Trump finds it difficult to reduce costs
item.description: President Trump is intervening in specific markets to ease consumer price pressures, as the administration faces growing scrutiny over inflation.

item.title: Scoop: Mike Rogers-AIPAC split shakes Michigan Senate race
item.description: Allies of Mike Rogers, Michigan's GOP Senate nominee, have asked AIPAC to refrain from advertising on his behalf, causing a rift with the influential group.

item.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's ballroom construction to proceed for now
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday permitted President Trump's ballroom project to continue, despite a lower court's previous halt on the construction.
